repositories.name: Zairenkai-Core
repositories.disposition: integrated: privileged control plane reached through root (zcored ctl); not packaged in the APK
app_capabilities: core.actions (fas_set_profile, fas_set_enabled, set_low_power_mode, with dry-run preview)
repositories.integration_mechanism: root bridge: su -c with a fixed argv to /data/adb/modules/zairenkai_core/bin/zcored ctl (protocol v1 JSON)
repositories.runtime_requirements: root (Magisk/KernelSU) and the zairenkai_core module installed and running; ADR-0005 limits the socket to root clients
repositories.license: Apache-2.0 at the audited commit (LICENSE, NOTICE); dev (455368f) has no LICENSE yet
repositories.evidence: crates/zcored, crates/zcore-domain/src/protocol.rs, module/, docs/adr/0005-root-only-socket.md at the audited commit; dev contains only foundation files (topic branch not merged) Re-audited 2026-10-21 at 34e93e3: adds the read-only ThermalTools adapter (thermaltools.diagnostics, thermaltools.sensors) and Apache-2.0; not merged into dev.

repositories.name: Zairenkai-FAS
repositories.disposition: integrated: frame-aware scheduling daemon reached through root (zfasd ctl); not packaged
app_capabilities: fas.actions (enable, disable, profile, reset) when Core is not running
repositories.integration_mechanism: root bridge: su -c with a fixed argv to /data/adb/modules/zairenkai_fas/bin/zfasd ctl (docs/INTEGRATION.md)
repositories.runtime_requirements: root and the zairenkai_fas module; telemetry needs SurfaceFlinger; never validated on a device (docs/TESTING.md)
repositories.evidence: dev 3f0daaefa317 = merged PR #1; audited topic commit adds enabled/default_profile to status

repositories.name: Zairenkai-ART
repositories.disposition: integrated: zart packaged as a native executable; upstream ART patch management stays build-time only
app_capabilities: art.inspect (ART module, ART/dexopt properties, page size, arm64 ISA config vs AT_HWCAP)
repositories.integration_mechanism: native executable lib/<abi>/libzart.so built by the repository's scripts/build-android.sh; JSON over stdout
repositories.runtime_requirements: inspect: none (runs as the app uid; some inputs may be denied by SELinux); dexopt-status: root
repositories.license: none chosen; Apache-2.0 data from AOSP ART in crates/zart/src/isa.rs
repositories.evidence: crates/zart, upstream/, tools/art_upstream.py at the audited commit; dev contains only foundation files

repositories.name: Zairenkai-Database-Source

repositories.license: code Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); packaged data CC BY-SA 3.0 (NOTICE)

repositories.name: Zairenkai-ThermalTools
repositories.disposition: integrated: zthermal packaged as a native executable; the app runs only `zthermal snapshot` (read only)
repositories.integration_mechanism: lib/<abi>/libzthermal.so executed as the app uid (`snapshot`), or through root on request (`snapshot --framework`); JSON schema_version 1
repositories.runtime_requirements: Read access to /sys/class/thermal (SELinux may deny the app uid); dumpsys needs shell or root. No writes: the validated control list is empty.
repositories.license: Apache-2.0 at the audited commit (LICENSE, NOTICE); dev (5358d4d) has no LICENSE yet
repositories.evidence: crates/zthermal (CLI), crates/zthermal-platform/src/snapshot.rs, schemas/snapshot.schema.json, policy::VALIDATED_CONTROLS empty; 0.2.0 at 9d4b310 (not merged into dev, which holds 0.1.0 at 5358d4d).
